LanguageData.LP_Feat_DualWielder.label: dual wielder
LanguageData.LP_Feat_DualWielder.description: Both hands always busy. Melee cooldown ×0.85, melee dodge +8, melee hit chance ×1.05. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ShieldMaster.label: shield master
LanguageData.LP_Feat_ShieldMaster.description: A shield isn't just for blocking. Armor +6%, melee dodge +6; while wearing a shield belt, another +10 melee dodge, and melee hits have a 25% chance to push the target 1 cell and stun for 1 second. Grants +1 Strength or Constitution.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_PolearmMaster.label: polearm master
LanguageData.LP_Feat_PolearmMaster.description: The butt end is a weapon too. With polearm melee weapons (stab / cut weapons of mass ≥2), the first hit every 3 seconds is followed at once by a butt-end strike (50% damage); melee cooldown ×0.9. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_CrossbowExpert.label: crossbow expert
LanguageData.LP_Feat_CrossbowExpert.description: Reloads as fast as breathing. With bows and crossbows (medieval-or-lower ranged weapons) aiming time ×0.7 and shooting cooldown ×0.8; all ranged weapons get shooting accuracy ×1.05. Grants +1 Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Charger.label: charger
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Charger.description: Strikes with momentum. Melee hits while running (moved within the last second) deal ×1.3 damage and have a 25% chance to knock the target back 1 cell; moving +0.2. Grants +1 Strength or Dexterity.
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Grappler.label: grappler
LanguageData.LP_Feat_Grappler.description: Once caught, there's no running. Melee hits have a 25% chance to keep a target no bigger than 1.5× your size from moving for 3 seconds; ×1.5 melee damage against grappled, stunned or downed targets. Grants +1 Strength.
